_help: Rules enforced by .claude/hooks/guard.mjs before a tool runs. 'never' blocks, 'ask' makes the user confirm. paths: globs relative to the project root ('secrets/' = that folder, '.env*' = any depth, '**/*.pem'); also absolute or ~/ paths. commands: case-insensitive regexes tested against Bash and PowerShell commands. Test a rule: node .claude/hooks/guard.mjs --check Write some/path
_rules: Chosen 2026-11-17: ask before pushing/merging to main (auto-deploys the live site used in classes) and before any force push; ask before recursive deletes. Added for attendance: ask before editing the calculator (dance-party attendance) and before firebase deploys.
